segments.plan: How a pot works, in the README's words
segments.title: How a pot works
lines: It can only come out to destinations fixed when the pot was created, and only when enough of the named approvers agree
Any funder can exit at any time with their share of what is unspent
Exits are never blocked by a freeze, a close, a pending proposal, or an approver who has stopped cooperating

segments.plan: What else the app does, in the README's words
segments.title: Also in the app
lines: Send dollars to another person, and receive them
Deliver a payment in another currency through Agora's Instant Settlement
People see dollars and names, never keys or addresses
